remaining: full local runner and preservation audit

workshop_backend.scope: X2 Workshop backend and additive full-document carriers

existing_server.timing: Imported implementation before final request-header and malformed-sidecar review refinements; current integrated full sweep remains required.

remaining_gates: Frontend real-browser integration owned by frontend agent
Current full sweep, artifact/preservation audit and shared report owned by main
No remote exact-SHA CI or native keyboard claim
limits: Single server serializes in-process writes; per-file atomic replacement is not cross-process multi-file atomicity.
Immediate I/O exceptions roll back completed pair writes. Unique originals remain; process interruption leaves mismatching pair detectably refused.
Modern carrier imports restore original metadata/parent identity; historical absent-arm restorers retain their old interpretation.
Selected native Keeper context is X3, unchanged here.

findings: GET profile snapshot and CAS token could straddle a concurrent profile save, authorizing an actual stale overwrite.
Null or missing modern carrier snapshot with surviving digest silently fell back to legacy reconstruction and lost parent/layers.
